title: Settings: General Settings - Social Media Tab
content:
The Social Media tab in General Settings allows site owners to connect their directory to major social platforms including Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and Pinterest.

Key Configuration Options:
1. Social Media Links: Enter full profile URLs. These appear as icons in your site's header, footer, and member dashboard.
2. Open Graph Meta Tags: Automatically generates Facebook OG tags and Twitter Cards for social sharing.
3. Social Share Buttons: Toggle social share widgets on blog posts, member profile pages, and event listings. Members can embed YouTube and Vimeo video showreels directly on their listing profile tabs.

Native vs Custom:
This is a 100% built-in native setting located at Settings >> General Settings >> Social Media tab. No custom coding or API development is required to display social links or share icons.

title: How to Import Categories via CSV File
content:
You can bulk upload hundreds or thousands of top-level categories and sub-categories using the CSV Import tool.

Steps to Import:
1. Navigate to My Members >> Member Categories in the Admin Dashboard.
2. Click the 'Import Categories' button at the top right.
3. Download the sample CSV template to ensure your column mapping matches: Top Category Name, Sub-Level 1 Name, Sub-Level 2 Name.
4. Upload your CSV file and select the delimiter (comma or semicolon).
5. Review the preview table and click 'Start Import'.

Important Limitations:
- Maximum 5,000 categories per single batch upload to prevent server timeouts.
- Existing category IDs are preserved; duplicates are flagged for merging or skipping.

title: Finance: Payment Gateways - Stripe Integration & Setup
content:
Brilliant Directories natively integrates with Stripe to process recurring membership fees, one-time lead purchases, digital product sales, and pay-per-post fees.

Configuration Steps:
1. Go to Finance >> Payment Gateways.
2. Select 'Stripe' as your Default Payment Gateway.
3. Click 'Connect with Stripe' or manually enter your Stripe Publishable Key and Stripe Secret Key (found in your Stripe Dashboard under Developers >> API Keys).
4. Enable Stripe Webhooks by copying the webhook endpoint URL from BD into your Stripe Dashboard (events required: invoice.payment_succeeded, customer.subscription.deleted).
5. Set currency (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, etc.) and toggle 'Test Mode' for sandbox validation.

Refund & Cancellation Policy Handling:
- Full and partial refunds can be processed directly inside the Brilliant Directories admin panel under Finance >> Transaction History by clicking 'Refund'.
- When a member cancels their subscription, Stripe halts future billing automatically and changes the BD member status based on your setting: 'Keep active until end of period' or 'Downgrade immediately to free tier'.

Shows input boxes for Publishable Key (pk_live_...) and Secret Key (sk_live_...), Webhook Signing Secret, Currency dropdown set to USD, and a green badge saying 'Stripe Connected Successfully'.

title: Finance: How to Issue Refunds and Void Invoices
content:
Site administrators can issue full or partial refunds for any paid transaction directly from the admin dashboard without logging into Stripe or PayPal.

How to Issue a Refund:
1. Navigate to Finance >> Transaction History.
2. Locate the transaction using member email, invoice ID, or transaction date.
3. Click the 'Actions' dropdown on the right side of the transaction row.
4. Select 'Issue Refund'.
5. Choose 'Full Refund' or 'Partial Refund' and enter the refund amount.
6. Enter an optional internal note (e.g., 'Customer satisfied with cancellation policy within 14-day window').
7. Click 'Confirm Refund'. The funds are credited back to the member's original payment method via the gateway within 5-10 business days.

Voiding Unpaid Invoices:
For overdue or pending invoices, select 'Void Invoice' from the Actions menu to prevent further automated collection attempts.

title: Lead Generation: Automating Lead Matching and Distribution
content:
Brilliant Directories includes an automated Lead Matching Engine that routes visitor inquiries to eligible directory members based on category and geographic radius.

Configuration Settings (Settings >> Lead Settings):
1. Auto-Match by Category: Match leads with members who specialize in the requested category or sub-category.
2. Auto-Match by Location: Match leads within a specific radius (e.g., 25 miles / 50 km) based on ZIP/Postal code geocoding.
3. Max Members per Lead: Define how many members receive each lead inquiry (e.g., first 3 members to accept).
4. Lead Acceptance Pricing: Configure whether leads are free for premium membership plans or require a pay-per-lead fee ($15, $25, etc.).
5. Automated Notifications: Instant SMS and email alerts sent to matched members when a new lead is submitted.

Native vs Custom:
This is a standard core feature in Brilliant Directories. A company does not need custom Zapier or custom webhook scripts for standard radius/category matching.

title: Design: Customizing the Homepage Hero & Search Module
content:
The Homepage Hero section is the main banner visitors see. You can customize the headline, background image or video, and search bar layout natively.

Customization Steps:
1. Go to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab.
2. Select 'Hero Section' widget type: Search with Background Image, Search with Video Background, or Centered CTA Banner.
3. Select Search Box Type: 'Keyword + Location', 'Category Dropdown + Location', or 'Single Search Bar'.
4. Upload your custom hero banner image (recommended resolution: 1920x600px, WebP or JPEG).
5. Enter Headline and Sub-headline text with optional text shadow and color pickers.

Custom CSS/HTML:
If a client requires a unique custom multi-step search widget not supported by default, you can edit the widget code in Toolbox >> Widget Manager >> 'Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search'.

title: SEO: Editing Meta Tags, Canonical URLs, and Robots.txt
content:
Brilliant Directories provides native SEO controls for all core pages, category search results, and member profiles.

SEO Management:
1. Static Pages: Edit title tags, meta descriptions, and custom OG tags in Content >> Edit Web Pages >> SEO Settings tab.
2. Dynamic Search Results: Configure SEO templates in Settings >> SEO Templates. Uses smart shortcodes such as %location%, %category%, %site_name% to generate unique titles like 'Top 10 Plumbers in Chicago, IL | MyDirectory'.
3. Canonical URLs: Automatically injected on all pages to prevent duplicate content penalties from faceted filter parameters.
4. Robots.txt and Sitemap.xml: Built-in XML sitemap generated dynamically at /sitemap.xml. Robots.txt can be customized under Settings >> General Settings >> SEO tab.

title: Member Management: Adding Custom Form Fields via Form Manager
content:
To collect extra information from members (e.g. Years of Experience, License Number, Spoken Languages, Social Media handles), use the Form Manager.

Instructions:
1. Go to Toolbox >> Form Manager.
2. Find the 'Listing - Contact Details' or 'Listing - Additional Details' form and click 'Customize'.
3. Click 'Add Field' at the top or insert between existing fields.
4. Select Field Type: Single-line Text, Dropdown Select, Checkbox Group, Date Picker, File/PDF Upload, or Rich Text Editor.
5. Specify Database Variable Name (e.g. 'license_number'), Field Label, Placeholder, and toggle 'Required Field' if mandatory.
6. Save changes. The field immediately appears in member edit profiles and on their public profile page.

title: Developers: REST API, Webhooks, and Zapier Integration
content:
Brilliant Directories offers a REST API and Webhook system for synchronizing data with external CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce), email marketing tools (Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign), or custom backends.

API Details:
- Authentication: API Key sent via Bearer Token header (Settings >> API Keys).
- Endpoints: Members CRUD (/api/v2/members), Leads (/api/v2/leads), Transactions (/api/v2/transactions).
- Rate Limits: 120 requests per minute per API token.

Outbound Webhooks:
Configure Webhooks in Developer Tools >> Webhooks to trigger real-time POST payloads to your server on:
- member.created / member.updated / member.cancelled
- lead.matched / lead.purchased
- review.submitted

title: Membership: Member Cancellation and Data Deletion Procedures
content:
Members can cancel their membership directly from their user dashboard if self-cancellation is enabled, or by contacting site support.

Admin Cancellation Control (Settings >> General Settings >> Member Cancellation):
1. Self-Service Cancellation: Enable/disable toggle for 'Allow Members to Cancel Account from Dashboard'.
2. Cancellation Survey: Collect reason for leaving (Price, Found alternative, Inactivity, Other) to improve retention.
3. Handling Member Listings: Choose whether cancelled member listings are immediately hidden, downgraded to Free Claim Listing, or permanently deleted.
4. GDPR / CCPA Right-to-be-Forgotten: When a member requests full deletion, navigate to My Members, search the member, click 'Actions >> Delete Member' and confirm hard delete. All personal identifiable data, uploaded files, and credit card tokens are permanently wiped.
